## Customer problem and product contribution

What specific problem does this solve, for whom, and what makes the approach useful
or distinctive? Which step of the unrecognized-charge journey and roadmap improves?

## Behavior and evidence

Describe the concrete before/after behavior. Include the reviewed revision and
relevant tests or demo traces, with failures and limits. Distinguish mocked CI,
manual native measurements and end-to-end customer outcomes.

## Hackathon and runtime fit

- [ ] The change deepens the selected customer journey and follows the relevant
      [review gates](https://github.com/mario-andreschak/factored-hackathon-2026-mcg/blob/main/docs/HACKATHON_SUPERVISION.md).
- [ ] Implemented tools and verified outcomes support every new UI/model claim;
      proposed capabilities and simulated policy/actions are labeled.
- [ ] Ownership, consent, failure/handoff behavior and permitted-data boundaries
      remain enforced outside the model on affected paths.
- [ ] Relevant data lineage/freshness and Spanish/Portuguese behavior are evidenced,
      or remaining delivery gaps are stated explicitly.
- [ ] Metrics disclose workload, denominator and limitations; provisional learned
      evaluation is not presented as the final independent held-out result.

State any new dependency, scope/architecture decision or remaining submission gate.
